brief.summary_1line: Bharata assures Guha he seeks to bring Rama back, not harm him, filling Guha with joy while Bharata spends the night consumed by grief for his brother.

image_candidates.scene_text: Guha, the forest chieftain, joyfully embraces Prince Bharata beside the Ganges as the sun sets over the gathered army.
Bharata sits alone in his tent at night, sweating with grief and clasping his chest as he thinks of Rama in exile.
Guha and his bow‑armed Nishada kinsmen stand before Bharata’s vast army on the forested bank of the flooded Ganges.
